reason: Brand new, no reviews, and they want me to pay a deposit for socks that only get made if 99 other strangers also reserve, with no delivery date. I already have a drawer full of fun socks, so I'm not taking that gamble.
objection: I've never heard of this brand and there's zero proof it ships. Pre-order with no date and a 100-reservation threshold reads like a crowdfunding project, not a shop.
would_change_my_mind: A Trustpilot page with real reviews and photos from people who actually received their order, plus a firm delivery date.
